description: Executable Candidate recipe of NVIDIA's model card for Nemotron 3 Nano 30B-A3B NVFP4: lmsysorg/sglang:latest-cu130 as named by the playbook (resolves to v0.5.20, build 94602c9c), pinned by arm64 digest, serving the exact model revision through sglang.launch_server with the playbook's flags, except that the card's reasoning parser nano_v3 is passed under its current SGLang name nemotron_3 (renamed upstream in sgl-project/sglang#19865; the pinned image no longer accepts nano_v3). Resource envelopes are estimates from the playbook's --mem-fraction-static, not measurements; physical Spark acceptance is pending.
title: Nemotron 3 Nano 30B-A3B NVFP4 SGLang single Spark (NVIDIA model card)
